AlternateTargets: has nothing to do with it
Senses.Explanation: There is none (沒) of the dealings, involvement, connection, or bearing named by the compound (交涉): 'there is no connection' or 'it has no bearing.' The records deploy this one literal sense in two ways. First, as a plain statement of no connection. Shitou says that speech and action have no connection (言語動用沒交涉), and his disciple replies that non-speech and non-action also have no connection (非言語動用亦沒交涉). Another line says, 'before the King of Awe-Voice, no connection' (威音已前沒交涉). Second, as a dismissive verdict on a wrong answer. Blue Cliff Record comments repeatedly use 'well, no connection!' (且喜沒交涉 / 且得沒交涉), meaning that the offered account misses the recorded matter. The verdict can itself be challenged: when a monk says 'well, no connection' (且得沒交涉), Yuanwu asks, 'Where is there no connection?' (什麼處沒交涉). Intensified forms include 'utterly no connection' (全沒交涉 / 總沒交涉, 82 combined instances in the cited count), often in the line that something has utterly no bearing on one's own share (於自己分上全沒交涉). The rhetorical question 'what connection is there?' (有甚麼交涉 / 有什麼交涉, 114 occurrences of each graph form in the recorded count) states the same absence by question. The headword occurs 1,389 times in 244 allowlist texts.
Senses.Note: One meaning, 'no connection' or 'no bearing,' with two deployments: a flat statement and a dismissive verdict. Counted forms include 'well, no connection' (且得沒交涉), 37; 'utterly no connection' (全沒交涉), 21; 'altogether no connection' (總沒交涉), 82; 'completely no connection' (了沒交涉), 38; and 'a place of no connection' (沒交涉處), 14. It is corpus-wide rather than a master's signature.

Occurrences.Kwic: 瞠眼睛云。廓然無聖。且喜沒交涉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Yuanwu Keqin as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云。且得沒交涉。師云。什麼處沒交涉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄): in Yuanwu Keqin's hall address, an unnamed monk advances the comment 'well, no connection'; Yuanwu presses him by asking where there is no connection. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give a personal name for the unnamed questioning monk.

Occurrences.Kwic: 後石頭垂語曰。言語動用沒交涉。師曰。非言語動用亦沒交涉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈會元. Shitou Xiqian gives the first headword-bearing statement, 言語動用沒交涉; Yaoshan Weiyan immediately answers with a second, contrastive 沒交涉 statement.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山曰。三千里外。且喜沒交涉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈會元. Yaoshan Weiyan is the exact speaker who says 三千里外且喜沒交涉 to Yunyan Tansheng; Yunyan is the interlocutor and biography subject.

Occurrences.Kwic: 威音已前沒交涉。祖師不西來。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄): in his own hall address, Yuanwu Keqin says that before the King of Awe-Voice there is no connection, the patriarch did not come from the west, and Shaolin has a subtle key.

Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): in his instruction to Huixin Zhao, Zhuanyu Guanheng says that merely memorizing abstruse sayings, even eloquently enough to make a stubborn stone nod, has no connection at all with one's own share.
